models_evaluated: GPT-4 with plugins and pre-translated English text

links.outcome: Ability of GPT models to express calibrated uncertainty in answers to board exam questions
links.effect: Models could assess uncertainty in their responses but were overconfident; a new 'confidence accuracy' metric was developed. No numeric values are given in the abstract.
links.quote: Moreover, the models could assess the uncertainty in their responses, albeit exhibiting overconfidence.

unlisted_practices: Adding plugins (external tools) to an LLM to overcome symbolic representation and current-data limitations
Pre-translating non-English questions into English before LLM processing

screen.reason: Evaluates GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 (including with plugins and translation) on German medical board exam questions; benchmark study measuring test accuracy and confidence calibration without evaluating an organizational deployment practice.
